robot: two Franka Panda arms side by side, each with a 16-joint Allegro hand (DexJoCo on MuJoCo)

frame.suite: DexJoCo's world frame: z up, metres; the robot stands at low x and reaches towards +x
frame.base_text: the robot base frame: midway between the two arm bases (link0), +X forward towards the table, +Y to the left (towards the left arm), +Z up; the right arm's base is at (0, -0.4, 0) and the left arm's at (0, +0.4, 0)

notes: The arms take flange pose targets (DexJoCo's own action: an operational-space controller with gravity compensation; it lags a moving target and stops where contact blocks it). The hands take joint targets; a hand's joint_positions in the state are the targets in force, the measured finger joints are in proprio_now (joint_pos group). Arm joint targets are available as execute_trajectory space native with action type joint_position (the service turns them into a flange target by forward kinematics). Cameras render on the CPU: ask only for the cameras you need. The episode ends by itself at the first success or at a task failure.

right.note: the right 7-joint Panda arm commanded by its flange pose (DexJoCo's own action); the flange (tcp_right) is where the hand is mounted, not the fingertips

ee.point: the right hand's mounting flange (tcp_right), not the fingertips
ee.mode_text: DexJoCo's operational-space controller tracks the flange pose target (it lags a moving target and stops where contact blocks it); rows are interpolated at a moderate speed

right_hand.note: 16 Allegro joint targets (rad): index finger 0-3, middle 4-7, ring 8-11, thumb 12-15 (joint 0 of a finger = spread, 1-3 = flexion from the knuckle out; thumb 12 = opposition); position-controlled; the state's joint_positions are the targets in force

left.note: the left 7-joint Panda arm commanded by its flange pose (DexJoCo's own action); the flange (tcp_left) is where the hand is mounted, not the fingertips

ee.point: the left hand's mounting flange (tcp_left), not the fingertips
ee.mode_text: DexJoCo's operational-space controller tracks the flange pose target (it lags a moving target and stops where contact blocks it); rows are interpolated at a moderate speed

left_hand.note: 16 Allegro joint targets (rad), mirrored: ring finger 0-3, middle 4-7, index 8-11, thumb 12-15 (joint 0 of a finger = spread, 1-3 = flexion from the knuckle out; thumb 12 = opposition); position-controlled; the state's joint_positions are the targets in force
